description: Owners and deadlines given across dialogue turns ('can you...?' / 'yes, by Monday'), not in one 'X will' sentence.
transcript: Next topic is the test plan for the new image.
Lucia, can you update the test plan for the USB download?
Sure, I can have it done by Monday.
And the release notes are still missing.
Yes, I'll draft the release notes before the review on the 12th.
Great, we agreed to freeze the image after that review.
